title: Remeasure Timing After the Final Measure
content:
# Remeasure Timing After the Final Measure

Window Replacement Contracts: the remeasure fee for the most recent completed customer-requested remeasure is multiplied by a remeasure timing share set by the calendar days from the final measure date to the remeasure date.

| Calendar days from the final measure date to the remeasure date | Timing share |
|---|---|
| More than 10 (the late-remeasure day count) | 1.25 (the late-remeasure share) |
| No more than 3 (the early-remeasure day count) | 0.75 (the early-remeasure share) |
| 4 to 10 | 1 |

Days are counted as the number of calendar days between the two dates: a remeasure on the day after the final measure is 1 day after it. The share multiplies the remeasure fee before the fee is rounded to the cent.

## Both sides of each boundary (hypothetical final measure on 2033-06-01)

| Remeasure date | Days after | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 2033-06-04 | 3 | 0.75 |
| 2033-06-05 | 4 | 1 |
| 2033-06-11 | 10 | 1 |
| 2033-06-12 | 11 | 1.25 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A remeasure fee of a hypothetical $80, for a remeasure 12 days after the final measure, becomes $100.00 (80 times 1.25).
